text: 15 games tonight. Celtics at Rockets pairs two top-five net ratings, Heat at Lakers has the tightest line, and eight teams play on no rest. Indiana is missing 89 points per game of scoring against Atlanta.

title: Memphis is the best team by the numbers
text: 6-0 with the league's best net rating (+14.7), second on both offense and defense.

title: Portland is 3-0 on the road
text: Third in net rating (+11.0), even with Ja Morant now out about four weeks.

title: Plus-minus told the Lakers game
text: Doncic was +27 in 35 minutes; Toronto's Jamal Shead was -27 in 25 off the bench.

title: Indiana is missing 89 points per game
text: Haliburton, Siakam, Nembhard, Nesmith and Zubac are all out tonight against Atlanta.

title: Oklahoma City is 17th in net rating
text: The Thunder are -0.5 per 100 possessions with Holmgren, Jalen Williams, Wallace and Caruso out.

title: Sacramento is bottom three on both ends
text: 0-6 with a -17.9 net rating: 28th on offense and 29th on defense.
